description: Measure the combined supply share held by the ten largest SPL token accounts and report mint authorities. Accounts are not necessarily unique people or wallets. Cost: 1 credit (0.0022 SOL). Example: {"mint":"EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v"}

mint.description: SPL token mint address in Base58 format, not a ticker symbol.

network.description: Solana cluster to query. Use mainnet-beta for real assets or devnet for test data; defaults to mainnet-beta.

name: analyze_token_concentration
